# list

List registered plugins in the environment

## Usage

```
ppds plugins list [options]
```

## Options

| Long | Short | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--all` |  | `bool` |  | Show all plugins (equivalent to --include-hidden --include-microsoft) |
| `--assembly` | `-a` | `string` |  | Filter by assembly name (classic DLL plugins) |
| `--correlation-id` |  | `string` |  | Correlation ID for distributed tracing |
| `--debug` |  | `bool` |  | Show trace-level diagnostic output |
| `--environment` | `-env` | `string` |  | Override the environment URL. Takes precedence over profile's bound environment. |
| `--include-hidden` |  | `bool` |  | Include hidden steps (excluded by default) |
| `--include-microsoft` |  | `bool` |  | Include Microsoft.* assemblies (excluded by default, except Microsoft.Crm.ServiceBus) |
| `--output-format` | `-f` | `OutputFormat` |  | Output format |
| `--package` | `-pkg` | `string` |  | Filter by package name or unique name (NuGet plugin packages) |
| `--profile` | `-p` | `string` |  | Authentication profile name |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `bool` |  | Show only warnings and errors |
| `--verbose` | `-v` | `bool` |  | Show detailed output including debug messages |
